df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

new_paid_search = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f'Number of NEW customers in PAID_SEARCH: {len(new_paid_search)}')

# Inspect the first few rows of new_paid_search
new_paid_search.head()"}
